text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"states a position early and returns to it in the conclusion","quality":"clear stance","description":"The essay makes its position on driverless cars explicit and keeps that position visible throughout the piece."},{"evidence":"mentions sensors, brake alerts, flashing lights, and liability","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"The essay draws on several specific details from the article to support its claims rather than relying mostly on unsupported opinion."},{"evidence":"sets up pros and cons before deciding","quality":"balanced reasoning","description":"The essay acknowledges both benefits and risks and then explains why it still leans its chosen way."},{"evidence":"asks who would be at fault in an accident","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"The essay raises a meaningful objection and treats it as a real issue that needs to be considered."},{"evidence":"has an introduction, body paragraphs, and a conclusion","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay is more clearly structured into parts that guide the reader through the argument."}]}
